macros.name: cuAsGregorian
macros.doc: Converts a date according to the Julian calendar to a date according to the Gregorian calendar.

macros.name: cuAsJulian
macros.doc: Converts a date on the Gregorian calendar to a date on the Julian calendar.

macros.name: cuDayName
macros.doc: Expands a numeric argument into a textual representation of the day of the week in the nominative case.

macros.name: cuDayNameAccusative
macros.doc: Expands a numeric argument into a textual representation of the day of the week in the accusative case.
